# SheenBidi

Unmodified `Headers/` and `Source/` from [SheenBidi 3.0.0](https://github.com/Tehreer/SheenBidi/tree/v3.0.0),
commit `cfe430e7375a7845b679adae9d51dac6deaa8858`. Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
The experimental text API is disabled. `scripts/build-text-deps.sh` compiles
its unity source into a local static library using the host C compiler.
